prompt: Edit the supplied local Focus game icon into ONE companion PREDICT action icon for Slay the Math. Preserve the existing painterly fantasy RPG material, double antique-gold circular rim with four gold diamond studs at the cardinal points, dark gunmetal/navy centre, clean beveled highlights and consistent visual weight. Change ONLY the central symbol: remove the cyan eye crystal completely and replace it with a luminous smooth cyan-blue crystal divination sphere hovering above a compact fan of THREE dark navy cards with gold edges. The sphere is large and simple, with a bright white-cyan four-point glint inside. It represents predicting the next card. NO eye, NO lightning bolt, NO up/down arrow, NO letters or numbers. Keep this design clearly different from the source Focus eye crystal and from a Draw Pile stack. Crisp stylized painted rendering, readable at 32-48px. Single centred icon, square canvas, entire circular frame and all studs visible, approximately 8% transparent padding on all four edges. Genuine RGBA TRANSPARENT background outside the circular frame; no checkerboard, floor, drop shadow sheet or opaque rectangular background.
